summary: Comprehensive testing of Zektrix UK Wallet System. Backend: 24/24 tests passed - all wallet endpoints working correctly. Frontend: Wallet page and Admin Wallet tab verified working with all features.

integration_issues.issue: Login form submission doesn't trigger redirect in Playwright automation (known issue from iteration_12). Token injection workaround used successfully.
integration_issues.note: This is a Playwright/preview environment issue - the API login works correctly via curl/requests

WALLET_TRANSACTIONS_API.description: Returns transaction history with proper fields

WALLET_DEPOSIT_API.description: Creates Viva checkout URL for deposit. Validates min £5, max £5,000. Returns checkout_url, order_code, transaction_id, amount, bonus

WALLET_WITHDRAW_API.description: Creates withdrawal request. Validates min £10, checks balance, prevents duplicate pending requests. Deducts balance immediately.

WALLET_BONUS_INFO_API.description: Public endpoint returns active, bonus_percent, bonus_max

ADMIN_WALLET_WITHDRAWALS_API.description: Admin can view all withdrawals, filter by status

ADMIN_WALLET_APPROVE_API.description: Admin can approve withdrawal, handles nonexistent IDs with 404

ADMIN_WALLET_REJECT_API.description: Admin can reject withdrawal and refund balance, handles nonexistent IDs with 404

ADMIN_WALLET_ADJUST_API.description: Admin can add/subtract funds from user wallet. Prevents negative balance.

ADMIN_BONUS_SETTINGS_GET_API.description: Returns deposit bonus config (active, bonus_percent, bonus_max)

ADMIN_BONUS_SETTINGS_PUT_API.description: Updates deposit bonus config, persists correctly

WALLET_PAGE_FRONTEND.description: Wallet page loads with balance card, tabs (overview, deposit, withdraw, history). All data-testid attributes present.

WALLET_DEPOSIT_TAB_FRONTEND.description: Deposit tab shows quick deposit buttons (£10-£500), custom amount input, submit button. Shows Viva Payments info.

WALLET_WITHDRAW_TAB_FRONTEND.description: Withdraw tab shows amount input (min £10), bank details textarea, submit button. Shows processing time info.

WALLET_HISTORY_TAB_FRONTEND.description: History tab shows all transactions with icons, amounts, status indicators (Completed/Pending)

NAVBAR_WALLET_BADGE.description: Navbar shows wallet balance badge (£0.00) for logged-in users with link to /wallet

ADMIN_WALLET_TAB_FRONTEND.description: Admin panel has Wallet tab with stats cards, bonus config section, withdrawal management

critical_code_review_comments: Wallet system is well-implemented with proper validation (min/max amounts, balance checks)
Deposit bonus system is configurable from admin panel with active toggle, percent, and max amount
Withdrawal flow correctly deducts balance immediately and allows admin approve/reject
All wallet endpoints have proper authentication (user endpoints require auth, admin endpoints require admin role)
Frontend has proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
Viva Payments integration creates checkout URLs correctly (MOCKED in preview - won't redirect to real payment)
seed_data_creation: Admin wallet adjustments created and reverted during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wallet system fully tested and working. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_wallet_system.py cover all 14 wallet endpoints. Frontend wallet page and admin wallet tab verified via Playwright with token injection (login automation has known issues in preview). Viva Payments deposit creates checkout URL but won't redirect to real payment in preview environment.
mocked_api_note: Viva Payments deposit creates checkout URL but won't redirect to real payment in preview environment - this is expected behavior
